units.normalized_content: Latent world W is observed through interface I as O_t = I(W_t); agent maintains hypothesis space H={H1,...,Hn}.
A hypothesis is called identifiable when some intervention/action sequence provides discriminating information, expressed as I(H;O|a)>0.
If P(O|H_A,a)=P(O|H_B,a) for every available action, the distinction is unrecoverable from the current interface.
For non-identifiability, proposed response is Epistemic Halt: preserve uncertainty and signal non-identifiability rather than force revision.
Observation failure: environment may be unchanged while observation channel is noisy/corrupted; filter/smooth/reject isolated anomalies without structural model revision.
Inference failure: model may remain correct under stochasticity; accumulate evidence and do not treat one contradiction as sufficient structural evidence.
Mechanism failure: relationships may change while variables remain valid; localize and update only failing mechanism.
Representation failure: current variables may compress away a necessary causal distinction; expand/restructure without premature overwrite.
Interface failure: if max_a I(H;O|a)=0, stop structural revision, preserve hypotheses, record limitation, and request information/interface expansion.
Hypotheses should retain why belief exists, supporting evidence, falsifiers, and discarded alternatives.
Goal is reversible commitment, including ability to reopen rejected hypotheses when new evidence invalidates the current model.
CFAE inserts diagnostic attribution between contradiction detection and model modification; error detection, attribution, and revision are distinct.

Procedure: suspend global updates; generate competing failure hypotheses; accumulate evidence against noise; choose diagnostic interventions; apply smallest sufficient revision; preserve belief provenance.
CFAE assumes factored model M={O_hat,T_hat,R_hat} for observation, transition, and reward models.
Observation residual e_O = d(o_{t+1}, O_hat(s_{t+1})).
Transition residual e_T = d(s_{t+1}, T_hat(s_t,a_t)).
Reward residual e_R = d(r_{t+1}, R_hat(s_{t+1})).
Contradiction when max(e_O,e_T,e_R)>ε.
CFAE compares H_shock (environment changed) against H_noise (existing model remains correct).
K = Σ_{t=1}^W log[P(e_t|H_shock)/P(e_t|H_noise)].
Structural revision occurs only when K>θ; otherwise contradiction remains uncertainty/noise.
When hypotheses remain ambiguous, choose a* = argmax_a I(H;O|a), prioritizing failure-source information rather than immediate reward.
If max_a I(H;O|a)=0, CFAE emits NON_IDENTIFIABLE_FAILURE, preserves competing hypotheses, and does not continue structural updating.
Choose minimum-norm ΔM subject to Error(M+ΔM)<ε.
Transition, observation, or reward failures update only the corresponding component; representation failure expands model structure.
Systems that attribute the causal source of error before revision are predicted to achieve higher adaptation efficiency than systems optimizing only error magnitude.
Evaluation framework extends final performance with recovery, structural-change cost, attribution correctness, and preservation of existing knowledge.
A_epistemic = (N_correct attribution + N_correct abstention) / N_contradiction.
Correct attribution means identifying the true persistent shift source, e.g. transition→H_T, observation→H_O, reward→H_R.
Correct abstention rewards refusal when evidence is noise-consistent, hypotheses indistinguishable, or interface non-identifiable.
Abstention is rewarded only when revision is unjustified; permanent refusal is under-update.
